item.title: Volunteers unite to deliver 1,500 meals to Chicago seniors
item.description: On Saturday, a legion of volunteers and organizations are banding together to give away 1,500 meals.

item.title: Matrix Club Banquet Hall closure leaves schools scrambling to find venues to host prom, dances
item.description: Schools in the western suburbs are scrambling to find alternate sites for proms and school events after the Matrix Club Banquet Hall in Naperville abruptly closed its doors this week.

item.title: PAWS Chicago Pet of the Week: Whiskey
item.description: CHICAGO — Saturday’s PAWS Pets of the Week is Whiskey, a one-year-old pup with lots of energy. Whiskey loves to play and spend time taking long walks. Think Whiskey could be the perfect fit for you? Head to PAWS Chicago’s Lincoln Park Adoption Center to find out how you can bring him home today.

item.title: Infant found dead in South Side home: CPD
item.description: Chicago police are investigating after a 4-month-old baby boy was found dead inside a South Side home Thursday afternoon.

item.title: Plane crash in Boone County under investigation by NTSB
item.description: A small plane crashed in Boone County, Illinois on Saturday, and the NTSB is investigating the cause and number of injuries.

item.title: Baby food sold across the US recalled due to possible health risk
item.description: CONNECTICUT (WTNH) — A baby food sold in Connecticut and 48 other states has been recalled due to a possible health risk, according to the FDA. item.title: 17-year-old dies after being shot on Chicago’s Northwest Side
item.description: A teenager is dead following a shooting Saturday afternoon in Chicago’s Logan Square neighborhood.

item.title: ‘I lost everything’: South suburban apartment fire displaces families, injures firefighter
item.description: Crews are continuing to investigate a large apartment fire in the south suburbs that injured a firefighter and left several families displaced early Saturday morning.

item.title: Sunday forecast: Unseasonable sunshine and warmth in Chicagoland
item.description: Jackets may stay unzipped Sunday as sunshine and warmer air push afternoon highs well beyond seasonal norms.

item.title: Hemp veto brings relief to Chicago cannabis shops
item.description: Mayor Brandon Johnson vetoed an ordinance that would have banned local smoke shops from selling intoxicating hemp products, providing relief to cannabis business owners in Chicago.
